proposal.name: Live summary of a running step in the dashboard's snapshot

plan.name: Live summary of a running step in the dashboard's snapshot
plan.summary: While a watcher formalizes, answers or builds, the dashboard's snapshot gains a live view of the step (Watcher.Live, a new type Live in internal/dashboard/live.go), read from the newest step directory's transcript.jsonl as runsOf finds it: the agent's turns (distinct assistant message ids), its output and thinking tokens (each message's largest usage output_tokens and thinking_tokens, summed), its tool calls by kind (Read is read, Glob and Grep are search, Write and Edit are edit, mcp__invariant__gate/check/test are gate/check/test, anything else other), an ordered strip of marks (one per tool call by kind, and a think mark per thinking block), when the transcript last grew (its modification time), and every file read or edited, as a path inside the agent's copy (the init event's cwd), with its reads, edits, size now (stat'ed read-only in the copy, keeping the last known size once the copy is gone) and which was touched last (Lit). The dashboard keeps its place in each transcript and reads only what's new, up to the last whole line, so a line still being written counts once it's whole and nothing counts twice; it keeps no code, words, thinking, tool output, tool inputs other than those paths, commands or the model, and a path outside the copy isn't kept at all (D-0051, D-0052). Checkpoints: RunMark gains the names of the checks that failed, and a build whose step directory has test-runs.jsonl (a plumbing build) shows its test runs with RunsKind "test". Left for later changes: the page drawing it (time dial, heartbeat strip, files, checkpoint markers, motion and prefers-reduced-motion), the watcher writing its time limit to its status file, keeping the ended step's view until the next starts, a faster refresh while a step runs, and -work given once per watcher.

tests.name: TestLiveCountsARunningBuild
tests.says: For a running build, the snapshot counts the agent's turns, output and thinking tokens, tool calls by kind, marks, last activity and files (paths inside the copy, reads, edits, size, the lit one) from its transcript, skipping a line cut off mid-write, and shows its test runs with the checks that failed.

tests.name: TestLiveReadsOnlyWhatsNew
tests.says: Once the cut-off line is whole it counts, and reading again counts nothing twice.

tests.name: TestLiveShowsNothingPrivate
tests.says: None of the transcript's code, words, thinking, search patterns, commands, tool output, model name, copy's location or outside path appears anywhere in the snapshot's JSON.

usage.summary:
I've planned the first part of issue #97, and the check passed on the first try. The dashboard's data for a running step gains a live summary read from the agent's transcript: turns, output and thinking tokens, tool calls by kind, a mark for each call and each stretch of thinking, when the agent last did anything, and the files it read or edited. It also shows a plumbing build's test runs, with the names of any failed checks. The three acceptance tests in `tests/internal/dashboard/live_accept_test.go` all fail on the current code, as they should.

- **Transcript format:** I assumed Claude Code's `stream-json` events, since it's the only agent backend in the repo. Thinking tokens come from a `thinking_tokens` field in each message's usage, which I couldn't confirm the real transcript contains; please check this before you ratify. If the field doesn't exist, that count will always be zero.
- **File sizes:** these are read from the agent's working copy while it exists, which goes slightly beyond the issue's "work directory alone".
- **Left for later changes:** drawing all this on the page, the watcher writing its time limit to its status file, keeping the view after a step ends, faster refresh while a step runs, and `-work` given once per watcher.
